en: Vintage sepia-toned art postcard reproducing a dark, atmospheric painted portrait of a bald man with a long mustache and beard. The image is framed by a cream border. At the top, printed text indicates it is from the Musée du Luxembourg. At the bottom, printed text credits the artist E. Carrière and titles the work as a portrait of Verlaine. A small artist's signature is visible in the lower left of the image.
